slashblade.jei.forge: Forge this blade on an anvil with the shown material box. Cost: %s levels.

slashblade.jei.progress: Follow the crafting recipes. Hover the required blade for kills, ProudSoul, refine and enchantment thresholds. Upgrade crafting keeps your progress.

slashblade.route.slashblade: Craft: 1 × blaze rod, 2 × gold ingot, 1 × blue dye, 1 × Sharpness -White-, 1 × coal block, 1 × string. Required blade: broken.
slashblade.route.slashblade_silverbamboo: Craft: 1 × egg, 1 × iron ingot, 2 × string, 1 × Anonymity -Bamboo Light-, 1 × black dye, 1 × paper.
slashblade.route.slashblade_white: Craft: 2 × Blade Soul Ingot, 1 × Anonymity -Wood-, 1 × gold ingot.
slashblade.route.agito: Craft: 4 × Proud Soul, 1 × Rust -Agito-. Required blade: kills ≥ 100.
slashblade.route.agito_rust: Requires Twilight Forest: Naga drops it at 30%, +10 percentage points per Looting level. No substitute crafting recipe.
slashblade.route.doutanuki: Craft: 2 × Blade Soul Sphere, 1 × Sabigatana. Required blade: kills ≥ 100; ProudSoul ≥ 1,000; refine ≥ 10.
slashblade.route.fox_black: Craft: 1 × obsidian, 1 × feathers, 1 × blaze powder, 1 × Sharpness -nameless- Ruby, 1 × Blade Soul Crystal, 1 × crops wheat, 1 × quartz block. Required blade: smite 1.
slashblade.route.fox_white: Craft: 1 × obsidian, 1 × feathers, 1 × blaze powder, 1 × Sharpness -nameless- Ruby, 1 × Blade Soul Crystal, 1 × crops wheat, 1 × quartz block. Required blade: looting 1.
slashblade.route.koseki: Place an unnamed basic SlashBlade on a blade stand and let a Wither explosion strike the stand.
slashblade.route.muramasa: Craft: 8 × Blade Soul Sphere, 1 × Anonymity -Nameless-. Required blade: ProudSoul ≥ 10,000; refine ≥ 20.
slashblade.route.orotiagito: Craft: 4 × Proud Soul, 4 × Blade Soul Sphere, 1 × -Agito-. Required blade: kills ≥ 1,000; ProudSoul ≥ 1,000; refine ≥ 10.
slashblade.route.orotiagito_rust: Requires Twilight Forest: Hydra drops it at 30%, +10 percentage points per Looting level. No substitute crafting recipe.
slashblade.route.orotiagito_sealed: Craft: 4 × Proud Soul, 1 × Rust -Agito-. Required blade: kills ≥ 100.
slashblade.route.rodai_diamond: Craft: 1 × Blade Soul Trapezohedron, 1 × Noted -Silver Bamboo Light-, 1 × diamond sword, 1 × string. Required blade: kills ≥ 100; broken.
slashblade.route.rodai_golden: Craft: 1 × Blade Soul Crystal, 1 × Noted -Silver Bamboo Light-, 1 × golden sword, 1 × string. Required blade: kills ≥ 100; broken.
slashblade.route.rodai_iron: Craft: 1 × Blade Soul Crystal, 1 × Noted -Silver Bamboo Light-, 1 × iron sword, 1 × string. Required blade: kills ≥ 100; broken.
slashblade.route.rodai_netherite: Craft: 1 × Blade Soul Trapezohedron, 1 × Noted -Silver Bamboo Light-, 1 × netherite sword, 1 × string. Required blade: kills ≥ 100; broken. Alternatively, smith Diamond Rodai with a Netherite Upgrade Template and a Netherite Ingot; progress is retained.
slashblade.route.rodai_stone: Craft: 1 × Blade Soul Crystal, 1 × Noted -Silver Bamboo Light-, 1 × stone sword, 1 × string. Required blade: kills ≥ 100; broken.
slashblade.route.rodai_wooden: Craft: 1 × Blade Soul Crystal, 1 × Noted -Silver Bamboo Light-, 1 × wooden sword, 1 × string. Required blade: kills ≥ 100; broken.
slashblade.route.ruby: Craft: 1 × red dye, 2 × Blade Soul Ingot, 1 × Proud Soul, 1 × Noted -Silver Bamboo Light-, 1 × string. Required blade: broken.
slashblade.route.sabigatana: Zombies can spawn carrying this blade (5% × local difficulty multiplier, within the 15% blade-carrying pool). It can also be repaired from the broken, sealed variant with 2 ProudSoul Ingots. Normal equipment-drop rules apply.
slashblade.route.sabigatana_broken: Unarmed zombies can receive a blade on spawning: 5% × difficulty intact, the next 10% broken and sealed. Drowned and zombified piglins are excluded.
slashblade.route.sange: Defeat a Wither while holding a SlashBlade: 30% drop chance, +10 percentage points per Looting level.
slashblade.route.tagayasan: Craft: 4 × Blade Soul Sphere, 2 × ender eye, 2 × ender pearl, 1 × Anonymity -Wood-. Required blade: ProudSoul ≥ 1,000; refine ≥ 10; unbreaking 1.
slashblade.route.yamato: Craft: 8 × Blade Soul Sphere, 1 × Yamato. Required blade: broken; sealed.
slashblade.route.yamato_broken: Defeat the Ender Dragon. Broken, sealed Yamato drops at (0, 60, 0) in the End. Repair it with 8 ProudSoul Spheres.
slashblade.route.yasha: Requires Twilight Forest: defeat a Minotaur while holding a SlashBlade. 5% drop chance, +10 percentage points per Looting level.
slashblade.route.yasha_true: Requires Twilight Forest: defeat a Minoshroom while holding a SlashBlade. 20% drop chance, +10 percentage points per Looting level.
slashblade.route.yuzukitukumo: Craft: 1 × emerald block, 2 × Blade Soul Sphere, 1 × diamond block, 1 × redstone block, 1 × Anonymity -Nameless-, 1 × lapis block, 1 × iron block, 1 × gold block. Required blade: fire aspect 1.
slashblade.jei.refine_material: Anvil refining: cap %s; +%s ProudSoul per refine, costing one material and one experience level.
slashblade.route.broken_white.title: Broken White Sheath
slashblade.route.broken_white: Use the blade until durability is exhausted. The broken blade remains and can be upgraded.
slashblade.route.broken_imitation.title: Broken Silver Bamboo
slashblade.route.broken_imitation: Use the blade until durability is exhausted. The broken blade remains and can be upgraded.
slashblade.jei.stand_arts: Place a blade on a stand and strike it with a material. An SA sphere changes its art. An SE crystal installs its effect. A blank crystal extracts a removable SE. An enchanted Tiny ProudSoul copies an SA when its enchantment is already at maximum on the blade. Enchanted souls add one level: Tiny 25%, Soul 50%, Ingot 75%, Sphere/Crystal 100%.
